convergence_alerts.name: Social-Financial-Food-Climate-China
convergence_alerts.meaning: Five domains simultaneously stressed. Social-financial linkage is most dangerous: high sovereign debt + low consumer sentiment + declining institutional trust.

convergence_alerts.name: Geopolitical-Energy-Supply Chain (Emerging)
convergence_alerts.meaning: US-Iran ceasefire collapsed. Hormuz at 11% capacity. Signal board shows green due to 8-day data lag — live data shows amber/red.

convergence_alerts.name: AI-Regulatory-Geopolitical (Building)
convergence_alerts.meaning: GPT-5.6 gated by White House. EU AI Action Plan. Senate AI Labeling Act. Frontier models becoming strategic assets.

top_risks.risk: AI model misuse / autonomous agent incident

scenarios.name: Hormuz Escalation → Energy Shock
scenarios.description: US-Iran conflict intensifies. Hormuz <5% capacity. Brent $120-140/bbl. War-risk insurance unavailable. Inflation resurges.
scenarios.inverse: New ceasefire negotiated within 2-3 weeks. Hormuz recovers to 40%+. Oil drops to $70-75/bbl.

scenarios.name: Sovereign Debt Crisis → Fiscal Austerity Wave
scenarios.description: Yield curve inverts. Failed Treasury auction or ratings downgrade triggers repricing. ECB fragmentation spreads. Austerity wave hits developed economies.
scenarios.inverse: Central banks coordinate financial stability response. Yield curve control or coordinated rate pauses prevent disorderly repricing.

scenarios.name: AI Regulatory Bifurcation → Tech Cold War
scenarios.description: US formalizes AI model export controls. EU follows. China responds. Global AI market splits into three regulatory zones. Frontier models become restricted technology.
scenarios.inverse: Voluntary framework approach succeeds. Governments back off hard controls. GPT-5.6 gating was one-time precaution.
triggers: China response to US AI controls

scenarios.name: Climate Tipping Point → Adaptation Economy
scenarios.description: Heatwave season intensifies. Simultaneous climate events create cascading disruption. Food prices spike. Insurance markets withdraw from vulnerable regions.
scenarios.inverse: El Niño/La Niña transition moderates temperatures. Food prices continue improving. Current season is a peak, not a new baseline.

scenarios.name: Social Cohesion Break → Political Realignment
scenarios.description: Economic pressure + geopolitical anxiety + declining trust crosses threshold. Triggering event catalyzes mass protest movements across developed countries. Political center does not hold.
scenarios.inverse: Economic conditions improve. AI productivity gains materialize. Trust rebuilds through institutional competence. Current low cohesion is a cycle, not a trend.
